name: Smooth spiderwort
desc: Smooth spiderwort (Tradescantia ohiensis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Tradescantia ohiensis, commonly known as bluejacket or Ohio spiderwort, is an herbaceous plant species in the genus Tradescantia native to eastern and central North America.
